messages:
Asha: FYI — Northlane renewal meeting next Tues. They asked for a short SLO evidence pack (uptime by week, p95 latency for API, and any credit calc examples). We should also call out onboarding gaps that could affect renewal.
Marco: Thanks. Can we get a simple heatmap + rolling uptime and a short note on outstanding enablement sessions? I can own the customer-facing slide.
Jin: I can pull the metrics. Quick plan: uptime (7-day/30-day), p95 per endpoint, and one example trace. Will attach queries. ETA 24h.
Asha: Awesome — flagging renewal risk: customer says >95% feature adoption is a gate. Current adoption 72% (from enablement team). Add that to the doc.
Marco: For credits, do we want to show a worked example with prorated credit? Customers like seeing the math. Sample calc: credit = min(contract_cap, downtime_minutes / total_minutes * contracted_revenue).
Priya: Please include contract clause ref: Sec 4.2 (SLA credit cap) and call out that credits are the sole remedy. I can draft a 1-paragraph legal note. Need the downtime minutes and the affected billing period.
Jin: Query I'll run:
```
-- uptime by week
SELECT week_start, 100.0 * SUM(up_seconds) / SUM(interval_seconds) as uptime_pct
FROM service_health
WHERE service = 'api-redwood' AND customer_id = 'northlane'
GROUP BY week_start
ORDER BY week_start desc
LIMIT 12;
```
Also p95 latency by route:
```
SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p95_ms
FROM request_metrics
WHERE customer_id='northlane' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route;
```
I'll paste results into a CSV.
Asha: Great. Marco, can you include the enablement action items and owners (2 sessions left, CSM assigned + SE follow-up)? That will help show we're driving adoption.
Marco: Yep. I'll add a small table with sessions, owners, and dates. Also linking the adoption dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/northlane-adoption
Jin: Paste of quick numbers (preliminary): 30-day uptime 99.87%, worst week 98.92%, overall avg p95 = 210ms, heavy-route p95 = 410ms. Will verify before final.
Priya: Thanks. Also we need a one-line for renewal comms: "Credits will be processed per Sec 4.2 following validated incident evidence."
Asha: Plan for deliverables: 1) Draft evidence pack (metrics + one trace) — Jin (24h), 2) Customer slide + enablement table — Marco (36h), 3) Legal blurb — Priya (48h). I'll assemble and send to Northlane.
Marco: Sounds good. I'll do the slide and a short worked credit example. Any objections to including the trace (sensitive data)? We should redact IPs and session IDs.
Jin: Agreed. I'll redact and include only trace id and span timings. Example trace snippet:
```
trace_id: 8f2a...
service: api-redwood
span: backend.query 120ms
span: auth 20ms
```
deploy-bot: Deployment api-redwood/2026.06.15.18 applied to prod in us-west-2 :rocket:
Asha: :thumbsup: Ok team — I'll check back after Jin's CSV. Let's try to get the pack into the renewal folder by EOD tomorrow.
Marco: Got it. I'll hold a 30-min slide review if needed. Ping me when metrics are in.
Jin: Uploaded CSV to /shared/northlane/slo-evidence/metrics_1769200001.csv (will replace with final).
